summary.text: Barbara Gervin-Hawkins is a Democratic state representative from Texas who has represented District 120 since 2017 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Barbara Gervin-Hawkins assumed office in the Texas House in 2017.
In 2023 and 2024 she was assigned to the Ways & Means Committee and the Appropriations Committee.
